import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
const { chromium, webkit } = await import(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE);
const { PNG } = createRequire(import.meta.url)(process.env.PNG_MODULE);
const out = process.env.QA_OUTPUT;
await fs.mkdir(out, { recursive: true });
const report = { checks: [], failures: [], layouts: [], comparisons: [] };
const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';
const revealSelector = '[data-gallery-reveal]';
const pendingSelector = '[data-gallery-reveal-state="pending"]';
const pause = (page, ms) => page.waitForTimeout(ms);
async function ready(page, url = `${base}/gallery`) {
  await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.locator('.gallery-page').waitFor();
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  await page.locator('.gallery-page img').evaluateAll((imgs) => imgs.forEach((img) => { img.loading = 'eager'; }));
  await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-page img')].every((img) => img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0));
}
async function overflow(page) {
  assert(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= document.documentElement.clientWidth + 1), 'no horizontal overflow');
}
async function visitAll(page) {
  const height = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollHeight);
  const step = await page.evaluate(() => innerHeight * 0.65);
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y += step) {
    await page.evaluate((top) => window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'instant' }), y);
    await pause(page, 90);
  }
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.gallery-page [data-gallery-reveal-state="pending"]'));
  await pause(page, 850);
}
async function openProject(page, index = 0) {
  const button = page.locator('.project-card__button').nth(index);
  await button.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await button.click();
  await page.locator('.project-dialog[open]').waitFor();
  return button;
}
async function closeProject(page) {
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.project-dialog') && document.body.style.position !== 'fixed');
}
async function pixels(a, b) {
  const x = PNG.sync.read(a); const y = PNG.sync.read(b);
  assert.equal(x.width, y.width); assert.equal(x.height, y.height);
  let changed = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < x.data.length; i += 4) {
    if (x.data[i] !== y.data[i] || x.data[i + 1] !== y.data[i + 1] || x.data[i + 2] !== y.data[i + 2] || x.data[i + 3] !== y.data[i + 3]) changed++;
  }
  return changed;
}
for (const [engineName, engine] of Object.entries({ chromium, webkit })) {
  const browser = await engine.launch();
  async function check(name, fn, options = {}, init = null) {
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, reducedMotion: 'no-preference', ...options });
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const errors = [];
    page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(String(error)));
    try {
      if (init) await page.addInitScript(init);
      await fn(page, context);
      assert.deepEqual(errors, [], 'no browser runtime errors');
      report.checks.push(`${engineName}: ${name}`);
    } catch (error) {
      report.failures.push({ browser: engineName, name, message: String(error), stack: error.stack });
      try { await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${engineName}-failure-${report.failures.length}.png`) }); } catch {}
    } finally { await context.close(); }
  }
  for (const width of [320, 390, 700, 701, 900, 1100, 1101, 1280, 1440, 1920]) {
    await check(`responsive reveals at ${width}px`, async (page) => {
      await ready(page);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('h1').count(), 1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.project-card').count(), 12);
      assert.equal(await page.locator(revealSelector).count(), 20);
      await overflow(page);
      const settings = await page.locator('.gallery-page').evaluate((el) => ({
        duration: getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue('--gallery-reveal-duration').trim(),
        distance: getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue('--gallery-reveal-distance').trim(),
      }));
      const millis = settings.duration.endsWith('ms') ? parseFloat(settings.duration) : parseFloat(settings.duration) * 1000;
      assert.equal(Math.round(millis), width <= 700 ? 400 : width <= 1100 ? 480 : 560);
      assert.equal(parseFloat(settings.distance), width <= 700 ? 16 : width <= 1100 ? 22 : 28);
      assert(await page.locator('.project-card').last().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '0'));
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.project-gallery__filters, .project-gallery__load-more').evaluateAll((els) => els.every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1' && !el.closest('[data-gallery-reveal]'))), true);
      await visitAll(page);
      await overflow(page);
      assert(await page.locator(revealSelector).evaluateAll((els) => els.every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1' && getComputedStyle(el).transform === 'none')));
      const states = await page.locator(revealSelector).evaluateAll((els) => els.map((el) => el.dataset.galleryRevealState));
      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));
      await pause(page, 100);
      assert.deepEqual(await page.locator(revealSelector).evaluateAll((els) => els.map((el) => el.dataset.galleryRevealState)), states);
      report.layouts.push({ browser: engineName, width, ...settings, horizontalOverflow: false });
      if ([390, 900, 1440].includes(width)) await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${engineName}-gallery-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
      if ([390, 1440].includes(width)) {
        await openProject(page);
        await pause(page, 260);
        const box = await page.locator('.project-dialog').boundingBox();
        assert(box.x >= 0 && box.y >= 0 && box.x + box.width <= width + 1);
        await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${engineName}-project-${width}.png`) });
        await closeProject(page);
      }
    }, { viewport: { width, height: width <= 700 ? 844 : 900 } });
  }
  await check('15% threshold, real intermediate movement and row stagger', async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    const card = page.locator('.project-card').first();
    const pos = await card.evaluate((el) => { const b = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { top: b.top + scrollY, height: b.height }; });
    await page.evaluate(({ top, height }) => scrollTo({ top: top - innerHeight + height * 0.1, behavior: 'instant' }), pos);
    await pause(page, 140);
    assert.equal(await card.getAttribute('data-gallery-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    await page.evaluate(({ top, height }) => scrollTo({ top: top - innerHeight + height * 0.3, behavior: 'instant' }), pos);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('.project-card').dataset.galleryRevealState === 'visible');
    await pause(page, 50);
    const mid = await card.evaluate((el) => ({ opacity: Number(getComputedStyle(el).opacity), transform: getComputedStyle(el).transform }));
    assert(mid.opacity > 0 && mid.opacity < 1, 'actual fade underway');
    assert.notEqual(mid.transform, 'none', 'actual movement underway');
    const orders = await page.locator('.project-card').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((el) => Number(el.style.getPropertyValue('--gallery-reveal-order'))));
    assert.deepEqual(orders, [0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2]);
    await visitAll(page);
    for (const width of [900, 390, 1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
      assert.equal(await page.locator(pendingSelector).count(), 0, 'resize does not reset reveals');
      assert(await page.locator(revealSelector).evaluateAll((els) => els.every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1' && getComputedStyle(el).transform === 'none')));
    }
  });
  await check('all filters remember seen IDs and Load More reveals new cards only', async (page) => {
    await ready(page); await visitAll(page);
    const initialIds = await page.locator('.project-card').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((el) => el.dataset.galleryProject));
    const categories = await page.locator('.project-gallery__filter').count();
    for (let i = 1; i < categories; i++) {
      await page.locator('.project-gallery__filter').nth(i).click();
      await pause(page, 80);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.project-gallery__filter[aria-pressed="true"]').count(), 1);
      const reused = await page.locator('.project-card').evaluateAll((els, seen) => els.filter((el) => seen.includes(el.dataset.galleryProject)).map((el) => ({ state: el.dataset.galleryRevealState, opacity: getComputedStyle(el).opacity })), initialIds);
      assert(reused.every((item) => item.state !== 'pending' && item.opacity === '1'));
    }
    await page.locator('.project-gallery__filter').first().click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelectorAll('.project-card').length === 12);
    assert(await page.locator('.project-card').evaluateAll((els) => els.every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1')));
    await page.locator('.project-gallery__load-more').click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelectorAll('.project-card').length === 18);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelectorAll('.project-card[data-gallery-reveal]').length === 18);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.project-gallery__load-more').count(), 0);
    assert(await page.locator('.project-card').nth(12).evaluate((el) => el.contains(document.activeElement) && getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1'));
    await visitAll(page); await overflow(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(pendingSelector).count(), 0);
  });
  await check('dialog entrance, photo controls, immediate dismissal and list focus/scroll return', async (page) => {
    await ready(page); await visitAll(page);
    const card = page.locator('.project-card__button').nth(4);
    await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    const y = await page.evaluate(() => scrollY);
    await card.click(); await page.locator('.project-dialog[open]').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.project-dialog').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).animationName), 'gallery-dialog-enter');
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.body.style.position), 'fixed');
    await pause(page, 260);
    await page.locator('.project-dialog__next').click();
    assert.match(await page.locator('.project-dialog__counter').textContent(), /02/);
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
    assert.match(await page.locator('.project-dialog__counter').textContent(), /03/);
    await page.locator('.project-dialog__thumbnail').first().click();
    assert.match(await page.locator('.project-dialog__counter').textContent(), /01/);
    await closeProject(page);
    assert(await card.evaluate((el) => document.activeElement === el));
    assert(Math.abs((await page.evaluate(() => scrollY)) - y) < 2);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(pendingSelector).count(), 0);
    await openProject(page); await pause(page, 260); await page.mouse.click(2, 2);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.project-dialog'));
    await openProject(page); await pause(page, 260);
    await page.mouse.move(600, 100); await page.mouse.down(); await page.mouse.move(2, 2); await page.mouse.up();
    assert(await page.locator('.project-dialog[open]').isVisible());
    await closeProject(page);
    await openProject(page); await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close project', exact: true }).click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.project-dialog'));
  });
  await check('direct anchor and keyboard focus expose targets immediately', async (page) => {
    await ready(page, `${base}/gallery#projects`);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.activeElement.id === 'projects');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#projects').getAttribute('data-gallery-reveal-state'), 'static');
    const button = page.locator('.project-card__button').last();
    await button.focus();
    assert(await button.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el.closest('.project-card')).opacity === '1'));
  });
  await check('Contact navigation preserves project context and clears body locking', async (page) => {
    await ready(page); await openProject(page);
    await page.locator('.project-dialog__cta').click();
    await page.locator('.contact-page').waitFor();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.body.style.position !== 'fixed');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.project-dialog').count(), 0);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-gallery-reveal]').count(), 0);
    assert(await page.evaluate(() => Boolean(history.state.usr.projectId)));
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => scrollY), 0);
  });
  await check('initial reduced motion has no hidden targets or modal animation', async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(revealSelector).count(), 0);
    await openProject(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.project-dialog').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).animationName), 'none');
    await closeProject(page);
  }, { reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
  await check('live reduced motion also applies to newly loaded cards and never replays', async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('[data-gallery-reveal-state="pending"]'));
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'no-preference' });
    await page.locator('.project-gallery__load-more').click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelectorAll('.project-card').length === 18);
    assert(await page.locator('.project-card').evaluateAll((els) => els.every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1')));
  });
  await check('print exposes all mounted content without motion', async (page) => {
    await ready(page); await page.emulateMedia({ media: 'print' });
    assert(await page.locator(revealSelector).evaluateAll((els) => els.every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1' && getComputedStyle(el).transform === 'none')));
    await page.evaluate(() => dispatchEvent(new Event('beforeprint')));
    await page.emulateMedia({ media: 'screen' });
    assert.equal(await page.locator(pendingSelector).count(), 0);
  });
  for (const api of ['IntersectionObserver', 'MutationObserver']) {
    await check(`visible fallback without ${api}`, async (page) => {
      await ready(page); assert.equal(await page.locator(revealSelector).count(), 0);
      assert(await page.locator('.project-card').last().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1'));
    }, {}, `window.${api} = undefined;`);
  }
  await check('StrictMode open, filter and modal close remain functional', async (page) => {
    await ready(page, 'http://127.0.0.1:4193/gallery');
    await page.locator('.project-gallery__filter').nth(1).click();
    await openProject(page); await pause(page, 300);
    assert(await page.locator('.project-dialog[open]').isVisible());
    await closeProject(page);
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.body.style.position), '');
  });
  await check('touch viewport has upward-only movement and usable project controls', async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    const transform = await page.locator('.project-card').last().evaluate((el) => new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(el).transform).m41);
    assert.equal(transform, 0);
    await page.locator('.project-card__button').first().tap();
    await page.locator('.project-dialog[open]').waitFor();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next photo', exact: true }).tap();
    assert.match(await page.locator('.project-dialog__counter').textContent(), /02/);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close project', exact: true }).tap();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.project-dialog'));
    await overflow(page);
  }, { viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, hasTouch: true, isMobile: true });
  for (const width of [390, 1440]) {
    await check(`final geometry matches unchanged Gallery at ${width}px`, async (page, context) => {
      await ready(page); await visitAll(page);
      await page.evaluate(() => scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));
      await pause(page, 150);
      const actual = await page.screenshot({ fullPage: true });
      const baseline = await context.newPage();
      await ready(baseline, 'http://127.0.0.1:4174/gallery');
      const expected = await baseline.screenshot({ fullPage: true });
      const changed = await pixels(actual, expected);
      report.comparisons.push({ browser: engineName, width, changedPixels: changed });
      assert.equal(changed, 0, 'no final layout or visual change');
    }, { viewport: { width, height: width === 390 ? 844 : 900 } });
  }
  await browser.close();
}
await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, 'report.json'), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify({ checks: report.checks.length, failures: report.failures, comparisons: report.comparisons }, null, 2));
if (report.failures.length) process.exitCode = 1;
